name: Hyperdrive Connection Pooling D1 Teljesítményhez
description: Hyperdrive connection pooling D1 teljesítmény javításhoz. Opcionális - csak ha D1 query latency probléma jelentkezik.
archiveReason: Hyperdrive is designed for external PostgreSQL/MySQL databases, not for Cloudflare D1. D1 is already a native Cloudflare database optimized for Workers, so this track closed as an explicit architecture decision and remains archived as not-needed.
verificationNotes: Governance backfill on 2026-04-12: the archived decision remains consistent with conductor/archive/cf_hyperdrive_d1_20260323/spec.md and plan.md, and later optimization work continues to depend on this explicit not-needed decision rather than a missing implementation.
